meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: What floating-rate loans are priced on: shares of the external benchmark (mostly the repo rate), MCLR, base rate and older benchmarks, by bank group
meta.note: RBI, Lending and Deposit Rates release, Table 7 (quarterly, per cent of outstanding floating-rate rupee loans at quarter-end; dated here on the first month of the quarter). External benchmark lending began in October 2019 for retail and small business loans.
